description: Search Learnosity integration skills by topic or free text across id, title, goal, APIs and body, combining semantic and lexical matches. Returns query and results, best first; each result carries id, title, resource_uri, match_type (semantic, the exact field matched, or partial_<field>) and a snippet, not the body. Use it when the right skill is not known, then skills_read with a result's id for the full guide. To browse the catalog or filter by API use skills_list; for documentation articles use search_docs_sources.

limit.description: Maximum results to return, clamped to 1-100.

query.description: What the integration needs to do, e.g. "deliver an assessment and report the results". A blank query returns no results.

name: skills_search
title: Search Integration Skills
